entries.name: POP
entries.purpose: Experimental consumer-basket and alternative-index product inside the 1D3X ecosystem, intended to combine real index publication foundations with editorial context and an alternative index library.
entries.priority: P1 complete the smallest coherent POP V1 on top of existing index foundations

runtime.framework: Next.js App Router monorepo platform shared with SPIKE / UGA / Index Cortex
runtime.deployment: Live public surface exists at https://pop.1d3x.com/ through Vercel project day-1d3x with tenant 1d3x-basket; implementation lives on branch codex/basket-production-demo rather than current main
runtime.storage: Prisma + PostgreSQL for canonical index operations; .cortex manifests and internal ledgers for Index Cortex

current_surface: live consumer-basket public surface at pop.1d3x.com
real Big Mac and FRED ingestion scripts
SQL-backed basket persistence and publish-candidate module

retrieve_from_index_cortex: future alternative-index library references and commentary context
remain_canonical_in_pop_operational_stat: product routing and public POP surface
basket/index definitions chosen for POP publication

what_is_already_working: real Big Mac and FRED ingestion path
basket publish-candidate persistence layer in branch code
read-only Index Cortex bridge from ABVX
completion_blockers: POP implementation is not on current main; it lives on codex/basket-production-demo, so canonical maintenance branch/source-of-truth is still ambiguous.
Production DATABASE_URL is not configured for the day-1d3x / pop project, blocking real DB-backed ingest/review/publish completion.
Stage 4+ branch verification needs a proper branch-local install/worktree; detached worktree build via symlinked node_modules is invalid under Turbopack.
Alternative index library breadth is still narrow: real path is Big Mac plus FRED overlays, while Starbucks/iPhone remain monitored/seed and review-gated.
Branch head already contains at least one unrelated later change, so POP completion should be resumed from a clean bounded slice.
entries.next_action: Resume from the POP branch line, configure production DATABASE_URL for day-1d3x, run basket ingest/review/publish against real DB, verify pop APIs on the live host, then either merge or fork a clean POP-maintenance branch.
